reasoning: This is a lightweight HTTP microservice written in Rust using the Axum web framework. It exposes a REST API (POST /api/v1/text/contents) for detecting PII patterns (SSN, credit card, email) and custom regular expressions in text. It runs as a standalone server (bound to a configurable host/port), is containerized via a Dockerfile producing a release image, and is designed to integrate with the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator as a detection backend. All hallmarks of a service: network listener, HTTP routes, health endpoint, container packaging.
